adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. A template-literal always produces a (truthy) string, even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined`, yielding e.g. `"undefined: <...>"`, so the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback will never be used. This matches the finding and is directly verifiable from the diff.
